description: Claude Code Observability Dashboard - Monitor usage, costs, and performance

panels.description: skill_activated events in the selected time range
panels.title: Skill Activations

panels.description: API cost of requests issued while a skill was active (skill.name attribute)
panels.title: Cost While a Skill Was Active

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | skill_name!="" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) / sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.description: Third-party plugin skills are reported as "third-party"

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | skill_name!="" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])))

panels.title: Cost by Skill

panels.description: skill_source: bundled, user, project, plugin... invocation_trigger: how the skill was invoked
panels.title: Skill Activations by Source & Trigger

targets.expr: sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | skill_name!="" | unwrap input_tokens [$__range]))
sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | skill_name!="" | unwrap output_tokens [$__range]))
sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | skill_name!="" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range]))
sum by (skill_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | skill_name!="" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__range]))

panels.description: Distinct servers with a successful connection in the time range
panels.title: Connected MCP Servers

panels.description: API cost of requests that consumed an MCP tool result (mcp_server.name attribute)
panels.title: Cost of Requests Using MCP Results

panels.description: User-configured servers show as "custom" unless OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1

targets.expr: sum by (mcp_server) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name="mcp_tool" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json mcp_server="mcp_server_name", mcp_tool="mcp_tool_name" [$__auto]))

panels.title: MCP Calls by Server

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (mcp_server, mcp_tool) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name="mcp_tool" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json mcp_server="mcp_server_name", mcp_tool="mcp_tool_name" [$__range])))

topk(15, quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name="mcp_tool" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json mcp_server="mcp_server_name", mcp_tool="mcp_tool_name" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by (mcp_server, mcp_tool))

panels.description: Connection attempts per server; status other than connected indicates failures

targets.expr: sum by (server_name, transport_type, server_scope, status) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="mcp_server_connection" | server_name!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: MCP Server Connections

panels.description: Large results inflate the context window and token spend

targets.expr: topk(15, avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name="mcp_tool" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json mcp_server="mcp_server_name", mcp_tool="mcp_tool_name" | unwrap tool_result_size_bytes [$__range]) by (mcp_server, mcp_tool))

panels.title: MCP Result Size (avg)

panels.description: API cost of requests that consumed an MCP tool result

targets.expr: sum by (mcp_server_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | mcp_server_name!="" | unwrap cost_usd [$__auto]))

panels.title: Cost of Requests Using MCP Results by Server

panels.description: Share of tool calls approved without prompting the user
panels.title: Auto-Approved (config/hook)

panels.description: Each of these was a permission prompt the user had to answer
panels.title: Approved by User

panels.description: config: allow rule, hook: PreToolUse hook, user_permanent: always allow, user_temporary: allow once, user_reject / user_abort: denied
panels.title: Decisions by Source

panels.description: Tools with many user_temporary approvals are candidates for allow rules
panels.title: Decision Source by Tool

panels.description: Permission decisions for file-editing tools
panels.title: Code Edit Decisions

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name=~"tool_decision|permission_mode_changed" | decision="reject" or event_name="permission_mode_changed" | line_format "{{if eq .event_name \"tool_decision\"}}⛔ [{{.tool_name}}] {{.source}} {{.tool_parameters}}{{else}}🔁 mode {{.from_mode}} → {{.to_mode}} ({{.trigger}}){{end}}"

panels.description: Bash and PowerShell tool calls

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name=~"Bash|PowerShell" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json full="full_command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" | json input="command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format command="{{if .full}}{{.full}}{{else}}{{.input}}{{end}}" | drop full, input | line_format "{{.command}}" | regexp `^\s*(?:(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S*)|cd\s+(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S+)|sudo)\s*(?:&&|;)?\s*)*(?P<program>[^\s;|&()…]+)` [$__range]))

panels.title: Shell Commands Run

panels.description: Distinct programs, taken from the first word of each command after env assignments, cd and sudo

targets.expr: count(sum by (program) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name=~"Bash|PowerShell" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json full="full_command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" | json input="command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format command="{{if .full}}{{.full}}{{else}}{{.input}}{{end}}" | drop full, input | line_format "{{.command}}" | regexp `^\s*(?:(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S*)|cd\s+(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S+)|sudo)\s*(?:&&|;)?\s*)*(?P<program>[^\s;|&()…]+)` | program!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Distinct Programs

panels.description: Shell commands that exited with an error

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name=~"Bash|PowerShell" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json full="full_command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" | json input="command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format command="{{if .full}}{{.full}}{{else}}{{.input}}{{end}}" | drop full, input | line_format "{{.command}}" | regexp `^\s*(?:(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S*)|cd\s+(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S+)|sudo)\s*(?:&&|;)?\s*)*(?P<program>[^\s;|&()…]+)` | success="false" [$__range]))

panels.title: Failed Shell Commands

panels.description: Shell commands that reach the network (curl, wget, ssh, Invoke-WebRequest, ...) plus WebFetch and WebSearch calls

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name=~"Bash|PowerShell" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json full="full_command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" | json input="command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format command="{{if .full}}{{.full}}{{else}}{{.input}}{{end}}" | drop full, input | line_format "{{.command}}" | regexp `^\s*(?:(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S*)|cd\s+(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S+)|sudo)\s*(?:&&|;)?\s*)*(?P<program>[^\s;|&()…]+)` | program=~"(?i)(curl|wget|ssh|scp|sftp|rsync|nc|ncat|telnet|ftp|Invoke-WebRequest|Invoke-RestMethod|iwr|irm|Start-BitsTransfer)(\\.exe)?" [$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name=~"WebFetch|WebSearch" [$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Network Access

panels.description: Most-used programs across Bash and PowerShell

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (program) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name=~"Bash|PowerShell" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json full="full_command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" | json input="command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format command="{{if .full}}{{.full}}{{else}}{{.input}}{{end}}" | drop full, input | line_format "{{.command}}" | regexp `^\s*(?:(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S*)|cd\s+(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S+)|sudo)\s*(?:&&|;)?\s*)*(?P<program>[^\s;|&()…]+)` | program!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top Programs

panels.description: Top 10 programs per interval

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (program) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name=~"Bash|PowerShell" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json full="full_command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" | json input="command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format command="{{if .full}}{{.full}}{{else}}{{.input}}{{end}}" | drop full, input | line_format "{{.command}}" | regexp `^\s*(?:(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S*)|cd\s+(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S+)|sudo)\s*(?:&&|;)?\s*)*(?P<program>[^\s;|&()…]+)` | program!="" [$__auto])))

targets.expr: sum by (program, decision_source) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name=~"Bash|PowerShell" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json full="full_command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" | json input="command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format command="{{if .full}}{{.full}}{{else}}{{.input}}{{end}}" | drop full, input | line_format "{{.command}}" | regexp `^\s*(?:(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S*)|cd\s+(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S+)|sudo)\s*(?:&&|;)?\s*)*(?P<program>[^\s;|&()…]+)` | program!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Programs by Approval Source

panels.description: Every Bash and PowerShell command. Requires OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1. Expand a line for program, duration and session

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | tool_name=~"Bash|PowerShell" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json full="full_command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" | json input="command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format command="{{if .full}}{{.full}}{{else}}{{.input}}{{end}}" | drop full, input | line_format "{{.command}}" | regexp `^\s*(?:(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S*)|cd\s+(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S+)|sudo)\s*(?:&&|;)?\s*)*(?P<program>[^\s;|&()…]+)` | line_format "{{if eq .success \"true\"}}✅{{else}}❌{{end}} [{{.tool_name}}] {{.decision_source}} · {{.command}}"
